notesHint: Use a muted, seekable MP4 and a matching poster. Scroll the clip as you make one contextual point, then pause on a complete frame.
description_en: An unpinned full-bleed scene scrubs the supplied clip only when the audience scrolls; the copy settles early and the held frame stays still.
description_ko: 비고정 장면에서 휠이 무음 영상을 직접 스크럽하고, 문장은 초반에 제자리에 정착해 발표자가 멈추면 영상도 멈춥니다.
responsive: Keep the media full-bleed and the text in a readable center column; mobile captions settle before the .55 hold.
reducedMotion: Do not create or play video. Show the supplied poster and the complete copy as a still.
purpose: 실제 영상 프레임을 스크롤로 살펴보며 맥락 한 문장을 설명한다.

exampleCopy.title: 낮엔 공부, 저녁엔 동네 거실
lines: 해가 진 뒤에도 편안히 머물 자리가 있습니다.

sceneContract.fit: A supplied real clip whose visual change adds context to one concise spoken sentence.
sceneContract.unfit: Autoplay backgrounds, unrelated stock loops, unseekable media, or a claim that needs changing text during the hold.
sceneContract.requiredInputs: A seekable muted MP4 plus a representative poster. Keep the scene to one short contextual sentence.
sceneContract.scrollBeatSemantics: Scroll changes the actual video frame; when scroll stops, the clip pauses on that frame. Copy settles before the hold.
sceneContract.stableHold: At .55, title and support line are completely visible and video currentTime changes only when the user scrolls.
sceneContract.projectorTypeCriteria: Keep a translucent veil between every video frame and the centered copy; inspect bright and dark footage.
sceneContract.labelCriteria: Copy describes a visible, relevant visual detail; do not claim the clip proves an outcome.
sceneContract.mobile: Maintain full-bleed media with a bounded copy width; no negative title positioning or offscreen text.
sceneContract.reducedMotion: Load the poster only and present all copy with no timed playback or drift.
sceneContract.exampleContent: A short field clip illustrating how light changes along a walk; the poster is its matching held frame.
sceneContract.unsupportedReason: The visual must change with scroll input and remain still without it; timed playback breaks the presenter hold.
sceneContract.nextImplementation: Check that currentTime is tied to scroll and remains paused, then inspect the held frame, mobile layout, and poster fallback.
sceneContract.failureFallback: 영상의 이동이 발표 정보를 설명하지 않으면 장식을 끄고 안정된 스틸 이미지로 대체한다.
sceneContract.reviewNote: 선택 후보입니다. 대표 장면의 1440×900·1920×1080·390px·모션 감소 상태와 스크롤 역방향을 독립 검수하기 전에는 완성 템플릿으로 간주하지 않습니다.
